title: AI Visibility and Citation Plan
summary: Check how ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode answer buyer questions, investigate the pages cited in those answers, and turn the evidence into a prioritized action plan and repeatable recheck.
outcome: Know where AI answers recommend you, who they recommend instead, which cited pages offer a realistic opportunity, and what to change or pitch next.
boundary: A small repeated sample of logged-out web answers in one market. Counts stay separate by engine and question; no invented rank, composite score or promise of improvement. Public research and drafts only; no site changes, outreach sends or recurring schedule.

catalog_tools.purpose: Ask ChatGPT each exact question, logged-out, without forcing web search for the counted answers and with forced search for the separate source pass.
Find the business's own page that should answer a buyer question when it isn't linked from the home page.
Open the business's pages and the pages cited by each engine before building a fix on them.
Re-read a page once when the first read comes back empty or as navigation only.
Observe repeated Gemini web answers and available citations for the exact approved prompts and country.
Observe repeated Google AI Mode web answers and available citations for the exact approved prompts, country and interface language.

inputs: Website and target market (country and language)
Five approved natural buyer questions, brand aliases/domains and up to three rivals
Approved budget; optional previous checkpoint and list of changes since the baseline
outputs: Separate engine scorecards with exact mention, recommendation and citation counts and failed/missing coverage
Checked citation opportunities and up to three prioritized page fixes or outreach drafts
By-name accuracy check and a dated, like-for-like recheck plan
Private portable HTML report, CSV observations and JSON checkpoint with run receipts

cost.model: 45 buyer answers, nine by-name answers, five ChatGPT source-pass answers; up to 12 page reads, four fallback reads and two searches. Optional enrichment is separately quoted.
cost.notes: Inspect actual current prices before approving. Expected core cost about $0.30, excluding the host agent model; reserve at most $0.50 for the bounded plan. Missing tools or an unaffordable plan stop before paid work. A plan with fewer engines is explicitly labelled, never silently substituted.

approvals: Confirm questions, market, engines, sample plan and maximum before paid work; reuse explicit authorization for that exact plan
Recover existing run IDs before retrying; changes to scope, cost ceiling, engine or sampling plan require agreement
Optional enrichment requires its own inspected estimate within an approved budget
No outreach, website edits, publishing or recurring rechecks without separate authorization
compatibility: Agent Skills compatible host with an authorized Scrollport connection
Local private checkpoint files; Python 3 standard library for the optional deterministic HTML/CSV renderer
A Markdown report is available when the host cannot run local scripts
